title: Walkthrough Objectives

blocks.text: The main goal of this walkthrough is to complete the game 100% (The Golden Competed Trophy) in two playthroughs. There are two Trophies that are only possible to get in New Game Plus, which is why this walkthrough requires two playthroughs. Because of this, we have a lot of spare time to see content not necessary for 100%. This walkthrough was designed to see as much content in the first playthrough as possible, and experience everything else possible in New Game Plus. However, the objectives for each playthrough can be changed around if you prefer. There will be some work on your part, but this walkthrough is flexible enough for you to change things around to fit your needs. Here is the list of objectives this walkthrough will accomplish:

items.text: Romance every girl (option included for platonic routes if desired)
See every event option (except Summer Festival)
Finish the Mega Beef Bowl Challenge
Win every prize from the Vending Machine
Obtain all Trophies not listed in New Game Plus
Obtain the Hardcore Risette Fan Trophy
See Alternate School Club Social Links
See all alternate female Social Link routes (optional for alternate Sun Social Link)
Obtain The Power of Truth Trophy
Obtain Big Bro is Worried Trophy
